1479-2841-6157-8338.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bant Panorama.
1479-2841-6157-8338.description:
Fetch a land using Bant Panorama.
When the fetched land enters, Shuttlecraft Galileo and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Shuttlecraft Galileo triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1003-4247-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Phyrexian Walker is starting in your graveyard.
1003-4247-5006-8170.description:
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Phyrexian Walker spell. Then, activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat.

1981-2415-3899-7918.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Sifa Grent and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

944-2034-4871-7147-7817.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Paradox Shaper // Omit Variables by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Planar Gate.
Repeat.

3532-5078-6747-7742.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-6747-7742.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Machinesmith Automaton triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Machinesmith Automaton.
Repeat.

1550-2105-7297.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of Hearth and Home attached to any creature you control except Combat Celebrant.
An opponent is unable to block Combat Celebrant or the creature with Sword of Hearth and Home attached.
You have not exerted Combat Celebrant this turn.
1550-2105-7297.description:
Declare the creature with Sword of Hearth and Home and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Sword of Hearth and Home attached.
Sword of Hearth and Home triggers, exiling Combat Celebrant, then causing you to search your library for a basic land card, then put the land and Combat Celebrant onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

1765-5231-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Chishiro triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Chishiro triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

6797-7084-7201.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Sapling Nursery triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

539-4657-7175.easyPrerequisites: You control two mana-producing lands other than Magus of the Candelabra.
539-4657-7175.description:
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Lavaleaper triggers twice, adding {2}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping the two lands and Magus of the Candelabra.
Repeat.

273-4924-7070.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature with base toughness 2 or greater.
273-4924-7070.description:
Activate Shuko's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The Shuko ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to Heartless Summoning.
Repeat.

147-2921-6933.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-2921-6933.description:
Cast Incarnation Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Incarnation Technique.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Incarnation Technique, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Incarnation Technique copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

3705-4314-5231-6896.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
When Squee dies, Pawn of Ulamog triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature token, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R} due to Green Goblin.
Repeat.

141-6797-6929.description:
Cast Behold the Sinister Six! by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Behold the Sinister Six!.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Behold the Sinister Six!, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the Behold the Sinister Six! copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-6797-6929.notes: You can return up to five additional creatures if desired using the Behold the Sinister Six! copy. You can also repeatedly sacrifice them to infinitely recur them.

147-3890-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card with mana value 3 or less in your graveyard.
147-3890-5231.description:
Cast Unearth by paying {B}, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}. 
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Unearth.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Unearth, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Unearth copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

851-1563-2457-4927.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

225-1479-2374-5700-5701.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
You are able to play a land this turn.
225-1479-2374-5700-5701.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Maja trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Maja trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Maja and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Maja trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Maja triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

643-4321-4508-5880.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure and Food token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1418-4636-5159.description:
At the beginning of combat, Mishra triggers, creating a 4/4 artifact creature token copy of Gonti's Aether Heart named Mishra's Warform.
When Mishra's Warform enters the battlefield, it and Gonti's Aether Heart trigger twice each, causing you to get eight {E}.
Activate Mishra's Warform by paying eight {E} and exiling it, taking an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

974-4183-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
974-4183-4222.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Smaug with haste.
Put either Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Smaug token dies, it triggers, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{U}{R}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Saheeli.
Repeat from step 3.
Once you have infinite mana, you may target any other creature(s) or artifact(s) you control.

539-1778-2232-2374.description:
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
When Memnite enters the battlefield as a Forest land due to Ashaya, Maja triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Warrior creature token.
When the Human Warrior enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Memnite to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

2284-4067-4463.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one untapped creature.
2284-4067-4463.description:
Activate Glare of Subdual by tapping an untapped creature you control, tapping a creature an opponent controls.
Verity Circle triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping a creature you control.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this loop during each turn.

1157-1806-3002-3263-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {2}.
Eternal Scourge is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard due to Rest in Peace.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {1}.
Repeat.

1020-2034-3003-3689.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Workshop Assistant, adding {C}{C}.
Workshop Assistant dies, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}.
Myr Retriever dies, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying at most {1}.
Repeat.

4050-4215-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a green nontoken creature.
4050-4215-5220.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a green nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Verdant Succession and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, returning the creature from your library to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1978-4667-5056.description:
Cause Elvish Aberration to become an artifact using Neurok Transmuter.
Activate Elvish Aberration by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Elvish Aberration.
Repeat from step 2.

471-2060-3233-4120.description:
Cast Saving Grace by paying {1}{W}, targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Saving Grace enters the battlefield and triggers, causing all damage that would be dealt to you and to permanents you control this turn to be dealt to Crystalline Crawler instead.
Activate Pestilence Demon by paying {B}, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and each creature they control, and attempting to deal 1 damage to you and each creature you control.
Saving Grace redirects that damage to Crystalline Crawler.
Vigor's replacement effect prevents that damage and puts that many +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler instead.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first activated ability by removing a +1/+1 counter, adding {B}.
Repeat from step 3.

1697-3750.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least five cards in hand.
An opponent cannot block Neheb.
Neheb does not have summoning sickness.
1697-3750.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Neheb.
Neheb triggers, causing you to discard five cards from your hand, draw five cards, and add {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
